[{"insert":"Strict Pull Up

Your pulling strength runs as a mechanical drop set this cycle, built around switching grip rather than dropping weight. Start with pronated strict pull ups at a 21X1 tempo, using only as much assistance as you need to hit the reps clean, then flip to a supinated grip and go for max unbroken reps at the same load. The overhand pull is the hardest, so once it fails the underhand grip lets you keep working the same muscles. Reps start at ten this week and come down as the block goes on, so stay strict with no kip and own every rep.
"}]
